name: 红队叙事
intent: 从样例文章抽象出的同等风格公众号模板。保留视觉节奏和组件规则，不复用原文内容、截图或账号品牌资产。

typography.bodyFont: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Segoe UI", "PingFang SC", "Microsoft YaHei", Arial, sans-serif

components.h2: Red filled heading bar with white text, 4px radius, 12px x 20px padding.
components.strong: Inline red emphasis with very light red background, compact padding, 3px radius.
components.image: Centered media, max-height 500px, 6px radius, 2px accent border, soft accent shadow.
components.blockquote: Soft red callout with accent border-left, used sparingly for conclusions or warnings.
